page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.48xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its massive memory capacity and dedicated high-core-count AMD EPYC processor, the ecs.r9ae.48xlarge offers high resource density for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. This hardware profile is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data caching layers, and complex memory-bound analytics pipelines where massive datasets must reside entirely in RAM to avoid storage latency bottlenecks.
